rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for deliberately failing to give something attention or care, especially in formal descriptions.

example.english: His disregard for safety regulations eventually led to an accident.
example.traditional: 佢對安全規例嘅漠視，最終導致意外。
example.jyutping: keoi5 deoi3 on1 cyun4 kwai1 lai6 ge3 mok6 si6 zeoi3 zung1 dou6 zi3 ji3 ngoi6
